Codie 1.6.0 HTTP API 内测接入指南

适用范围：运行 1.6.0 的 Codie 设备，供内测人员在局域网内通过脚本、桌面或移动应用接入。文档按 master 分支源码整理，不代表所有设备已收到该版本，也不代表全部接口已经完成设备实测。

文档包怎么用

解压 Codie-HTTP-API-1.6.0.zip，双击 index.html，即可离线搜索和查看全部公开接口的参数、请求结构、响应结构及功能权限；实际操作数和路径数见 manifest.json。无需启动服务或访问设备上的实验室页面。

文件用途
index.html完整离线接口手册，支持搜索与浏览器打印
guide.zh-CN.html / GUIDE.zh-CN.md中文接入指南
guide.ja.html / GUIDE.ja.md日本語接入指南
guide.en.html / GUIDE.en.mdEnglish 接入指南
guide.de.html / GUIDE.de.mdDeutsch 接入指南
guide.fr.html / GUIDE.fr.mdFrançais 接入指南
openapi.json默认英文 OpenAPI 3.1 接口描述；API 工具仍需自行实现 HMAC 签名
openapi.zh-CN.json中文 OpenAPI；路径、字段、枚举及签名要求与英文相同
examples/local_api.py配对与聊天示例；文字模式使用 Python 3 标准库，麦克风模式依赖见脚本说明
examples/external_tools.py外部工具注册、连接及调用结果回传示例
examples/media_session.py临时图片、音频和视频会话示例
manifest.json设备版本、源码提交、生成时间及文件 SHA-256，用于确认文档批次

OpenAPI 的 info.version=1 是现有接口描述版本；设备软件版本为 1.6.0，另记在 x-device-version 和文档包清单中。

五种语言的接入指南均随包提供 HTML 和 Markdown，可从 index.html 顶部选择语言。完整接口参考的导航为中文，接口描述默认英文；OpenAPI 提供默认英文 openapi.json 和中文 openapi.zh-CN.json。接口路径、字段名、枚举值和示例代码保持一致。

1. 准备设备

1. 确认设备已安装 1.6.0，并已登录用户账号。

2. 电脑与设备在可互通的局域网中，准备设备 IP。默认 HTTP 地址是 http://DEVICE_IP:8081，如设备修改过端口，以实际端口为准。

3. 发送对话前，先唤醒并解锁设备。接口使用设备当前用户和当前角色槽位。

4. 先用下面的在线检测确认网络连通，再运行示例完成配对。

curl http://DEVICE_IP:8081/v1/api/auth/ping

HTTP 基础路径为 /v1/api。完整请求地址示例：http://DEVICE_IP:8081/v1/api/data/user/system。示例脚本的设备地址只填主机及端口，不加 /v1/api。

2. 先跑通文字对话

解压后在文档包目录中执行，Python 示例：

python examples/local_api.py http://DEVICE_IP:8081 "你好" --credentials credentials.json

首次运行会让设备显示配对码，在终端输入该码。示例会保存凭据，读取当前槽位，提交一轮文字对话，再查询并输出角色回复。后续运行复用同一个凭据文件。

需要设备播放回复时，增加 --speech device：

python examples/local_api.py http://DEVICE_IP:8081 "你好" --credentials credentials.json --speech device --timeout 180

默认 --speech none，不播放回复语音；默认等待 120 秒。device 模式的 completed 表示生成与设备播放均已完成。超时不等于服务端轮次已取消，示例会输出轮次编号，供继续查询。

示例默认申请 session 凭据：有效期 12 小时，设备服务重启后失效。需要现有长期凭据时，在首次配对增加 --auth-scope permanent。session 可调用公开用户接口；管理接口要求 permanent 凭据，设备功能权限仍然适用。旧凭据文件不会被覆盖或自动升级；重新配对时请指定新的文件名。凭据包含设备访问密钥，应由使用者自行保管，不随问题反馈或文档包转发。

3. 自行实现配对

以下五个操作无需 HMAC，其余公开 HTTP 操作需要签名：

方法路径（含基础路径）用途
GET/v1/api/auth/ping在线检测
GET/v1/api/auth/bootstrap获取当前 user_id、登录状态及语言
POST/v1/api/auth/pair/request请求在设备上显示配对码，返回 challenge_id，请求有效期 5 分钟
POST/v1/api/auth/pair/confirm提交配对码，获取凭据
POST/v1/api/auth/pair/cancel取消配对请求

确认配对的 JSON 正文：

{
  "challenge_id": "使用 pair/request 返回的值",
  "pairing_code": "设备显示的配对码",
  "auth_scope": "session"
}

auth_scope 支持 session、permanent；接口省略时默认 permanent，示例显式使用 session。保存响应 data.local_secret、data.local_session_id、data.local_session_expires_at_ms、data.auth_scope，以及 bootstrap 的 data.user_id。脚本和原生应用可以不发送 Origin/Referer；浏览器接入仍受设备已有来源检查约束。

4. 每个业务请求都要签名

规范串按以下顺序拼接，分隔符为 |，末尾没有换行：

METHOD|PATH|TIMESTAMP|NONCE|PAYLOAD_MODE|BODY_HASH|USER_ID
signature = hex_lower(HMAC_SHA256(UTF8(local_secret), UTF8(canonical)))
请求头填写方式
X-Local-Sig上述签名，64 位小写十六进制字符串
X-Local-TimestampUnix 秒数字符串，允许与设备时间相差 300 秒
X-Local-Nonce每次请求生成新随机值，推荐 UUID；长度 1～128，不能含竖线或换行
X-Local-Payload-Mode按下表选择
X-Local-Body-Hash按下表填写
X-Local-User-Idbootstrap 返回的当前 user_id
X-Local-Session-Id配对返回的 local_session_id 非空时必传

METHOD 使用大写；PATH 使用含 /v1/api 的 URL 解码后路径，不含主机和查询字符串。密钥使用 local_secret 原始字符串的 UTF-8 字节，不能先做十六进制解码。签名和发送必须使用完全相同的正文字节，不能签名后再次格式化 JSON。

正文类型PAYLOAD_MODEBODY_HASH
无正文empty空字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制值
JSONjson实际 JSON 正文字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制值
文件表单multipart固定字符串 UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD
zstd 压缩上传分块zstd-stream实际压缩分块字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制值
gzip 压缩上传分块gzip-stream实际压缩分块字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制值

无正文哈希：e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855。压缩分块使用 application/octet-stream，仅用于手册明确支持的上传接口。文件表单应由 HTTP 库生成包含 boundary 的 Content-Type。

5. 统一对话 API

方法路径（相对于 /v1/api）用途
POST/data/user/chat/turns创建一轮对话
GET/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}查询本轮状态、转写和回复
POST/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}/input/complete结束设备麦克风输入，继续生成回复；空正文
POST/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}/cancel取消本轮输入、生成及播放；空正文

先调用 GET /data/user/slot 取得 data.slot_number。创建文字对话的正文如下，其中 request_id 每个新业务轮次使用新的 UUID，slot 换成当前槽位：

{
  "request_id": "3f743580-bd45-4c24-96c0-61a67ac5f741",
  "slot": 1,
  "input": {"type": "text", "text": "你好"},
  "output": {"speech": "none"}
}
输入Content-Type内容
textapplication/jsoninput.text 必填，去除首尾空白后非空，最多 16000 字符
device_microphoneapplication/json由设备麦克风录音，不传 text；结束输入使用 input/complete
image_textmultipart/form-datarequest 字段为上述配置的 JSON 字符串，input.type=image_text，可附 text；文件字段为 image
audio_filemultipart/form-datarequest 字段为配置 JSON 字符串，input.type=audio_file，不传 text；文件字段为 audio

图片或 WAV 文件最多 1 MiB。WAV 仅支持 PCM16、16 kHz、单声道、最长 30 秒。output.speech 必填，可为 none、device 或 client；请求不接受未知字段。

可选 interrupt 默认为 true：轮次开始时设备正在对话、播报或执行任务，会先结束当前会话。设为 false 时不打断，轮次以 failed 结束，error.code=DEVICE_BUSY（retryable=true），本轮已写入的用户消息从历史中撤回；稍后重试即可。

可选 retention 决定本轮在设备上留下什么，默认为 full：写入聊天记录，并更新对话状态、摘要、长期记忆和日记（它们都从本轮聊天记录抽取）。chat 只写聊天记录，不做这些更新。none 什么都不留：不写聊天记录、不保存图片、不做上述更新，回复只出现在本轮的 assistant_text 中，user_chat_ids、assistant_chat_ids 为空。三种取值下，生成回复时都照常读取已有的聊天记录和记忆。

可选 tools 决定本轮模型能否调用工具，默认为 all：模型可以调用本次会话可用的设备工具和外部工具。设为 none 时本轮不向模型提供任何工具，适合只需要一句回复、不应触发设备动作或外部任务的轮次。

还支持 input.type=audio_stream：使用 JSON，声明 audio.format=pcm_s16le、sample_rate=16000、channels=1、container=raw，音频最长 30 秒。音频流输入或 speech=client 须在受理后 15 秒内，以签名 GET 连接 /v1/ws/chat/turns/{turn_id}/audio WebSocket 并等待 ready。客户端输出按元数据接收 MP3、WAV 或 Ogg Opus，在 audio.end 后发送最终序号的 audio.ack；这表示收齐音频，不表示播放结束。断开即结束任务，不支持重连或重放。完整消息格式见 OpenAPI。

python -m pip install websocket-client sounddevice av
python examples/local_api.py http://DEVICE_IP:8081 --mic --seconds 10 --credentials credentials.json --timeout 180

创建成功从响应 data.turn_id 取编号，建议每秒查询一次对应轮次。终态为 completed、failed、cancelled；completed 时读取 data.assistant_text，失败时读取 data.error。transcript 提供转写，user_chat_ids、assistant_chat_ids 关联历史记录。中间状态不应当作最终成功。

状态还包括 queued（等待执行）、starting（建立会话）、receiving_input（接收录音或音频流）、thinking（等待生成）、responding（生成或交付回复）、cancelling（取消处理中）。input_complete 仅表示输入结束，transcript 可早于终态出现。device_microphone 最长录音 30 秒后自动结束输入，input/complete 用于提前结束。speech=none 仍会调用模型，只是不朗读回复；是否保存对话由 retention 决定。每次请求前可读取 /data/user/device/state 检查当前准入条件。

202 仅表示受理。同一凭据、同一 request_id、相同内容在暂存期限内重放返回原轮次；内容不同返回 409 REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT。重试 HTTP 请求仍须生成新的签名 nonce。interrupt=true 时，新轮次会停止旧会话；相同请求重放不会重复打断。

轮次终态保留 30 分钟，最多暂存 256 个；设备服务重启会丢失轮次和幂等记录。角色或用户切换、凭据失效、清空历史会使旧轮次停止或不可访问。取消只能作用于该凭据创建的指定轮次。

独立文本播报（TTS）

将外部应用已经确定的文本直接交给当前角色朗读，例如 Home Assistant 的执行结果。这个接口不调用 LLM，不生成角色回复，也不写入聊天历史。

提交 JSON 到 POST /data/user/tts/utterances；所有路径相对于 /v1/api，沿用上文的 HMAC 签名：

{
  "request_id": "e14eec98-5f67-445f-b605-bcc0b23f8f75",
  "slot": 1,
  "text": "客厅灯已关闭。"
}

通过 GET /data/user/tts/utterances/{utterance_id} 查询。取消用 POST /data/user/tts/utterances/{utterance_id}/cancel，正文为空。

202 仅表示受理，读取 data.utterance_id。状态为 queued、synthesizing、playing、cancelling，终态为 completed、failed、cancelled；只有合成和设备播放都结束才是 completed，失败详情见 data.error。text 去除首尾空白后须为 1–16000 字符，JSON 正文最多 128 KiB；使用当前槽位和当前角色的声音、语言及音量。设备须唤醒且解锁；新播报会打断当前前台会话，新对话也可打断播报，不设播放队列。

同一凭据、request_id 和相同内容重试返回原任务（200），不同内容返回 409；request_id 与聊天共享命名空间。终态保留 30 分钟，与聊天共用 256 条暂存；服务重启不保留。凭据失效、用户/角色切换或清除历史会终止或使旧任务不可访问，任务最长 180 秒。接口不返回音频文件或音频流。

python examples/local_api.py http://DEVICE_IP:8081 "客厅灯已关闭。" --credentials credentials.json --tts --timeout 180

playing 以当前播放流的设备开播回执为准。允许动画时，随机匹配一个 Talking 动画。取消请求受理返回 202；已在取消中或已取消返回 200，已完成或失败返回 409。客户端等待超时不会自动取消设备任务。

6. 其他业务与结果确认

完整路径、字段和响应以离线手册和 OpenAPI 为准：

分类内容
接入与配对在线检测、配对及取消
设备与状态系统信息、能力、设备与对话状态、AI 语言
角色与主动交互角色属性、槽位、模型服装上传与导出、加载、重置及主动交互
对话与历史统一对话、历史查询删除、聊天图片
记忆与日记查询与编辑
闹钟与备忘录资源管理及闹钟启停
音乐上传、文件管理、播放及状态
声音能力、独立文本播报、固定文案试听、控制及声音克隆
灯光作品、预览、编译、播放、应用及总开关
模型服务服务商目录、账号与测试、能力路由、系统提示词、架构及后端切换、最近运行错误

配对不会新增设备功能权限。先读取 /data/user/system 的 capabilities，再调用相应功能；手册逐项标出 x-capabilities。实验室 API 文档页面及 AI 服务配置向所有功能标签开放，接口继续使用现有配对签名鉴权。

接口成功可能表示保存或命令入队，不能统一解释为设备动作已完成。对话查询轮次；模型上传、应用、导出等查询相应任务或加载状态；音乐查询播放状态；声音试听查询 /data/user/tts_audition/state。声音试听仅接受 voice_id、可选 group_key，使用设备当前 AI 语言的固定文案，不接收自定义播报文字。

模型文件最多 200 MiB、声音克隆文件最多 10 MiB；音乐批量请求最多 200 MiB、64 个文件。普通签名正文及压缩上传分块最多 8 MiB。表单总请求还需包含字段开销，各接口的完整约束以手册为准。

可选实时状态通道：/v1/ws/events。使用签名 GET 握手，查询参数为 sig、timestamp、nonce、payload_mode=empty、body_hash、user_id，以及非空时的 session_id。签名路径为 /v1/ws/events，不含查询字符串。通道推送状态快照，不提供聊天生成文字流；凭据失效或用户切换等情况会关闭连接。

建连收到 ready 后，发送 {"type":"subscribe","request_id":"sub-1","data":{"events":["chat_history","chat_turn"]}}。等待 result 成功后接收事件；events 是完整替换集合，空数组取消全部订阅。重连后重新订阅，再通过 HTTP 恢复状态。公开契约仅包含 Release 构建和 RELEASE 标签均开放的能力；原始 OpenAPI 描述默认英文。

7. 常见问题与反馈

现象或返回码处理
无法连接检查 IP、端口和局域网互通，先调用 ping
401 REQUEST_EXPIRED对齐电脑和设备时间，重新生成时间戳及签名
401 NONCE_REUSED每个 HTTP 请求都生成新 nonce，包括查询和重试
401 LOCAL_SESSION_EXPIRED使用新的凭据文件重新配对
401 LOCAL_USER_MISMATCH核对当前用户，重新获取 bootstrap 并配对
401 LOCAL_SECRET_MISMATCH / INVALID_SIGNATURE核对原始密钥、签名路径、正文字节及各请求头
403查看响应错误字段及当前设备功能权限；配对不能绕过权限
409 SLOT_MISMATCH重新读取当前槽位
409 DEVICE_BLOCKED / AMBIENT_MODE_BLOCKED查看返回 reason，确认设备已唤醒、解锁且当前模式允许对话
413 / 415检查大小、Content-Type、输入输出类型和 WAV 格式
503按错误码确认服务是否就绪或暂存轮次数是否达到限制

OpenAPI 的错误响应 code.enum 列出聊天、TTS、闹钟、备忘录及设备克隆录音的本地 HTTP 错误码；操作的 x-error-codes.http 提供机器清单，x-error-codes.task 列出已知异步错误，提供方可能扩展异步错误码。HTTP 202 后的失败应读取 data.error。配对来源不允许返回 403 PAIRING_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED；幂等内容冲突返回 409 REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT；不存在的备忘录返回 404 MEMO_NOT_FOUND。

x-error-codes 还涵盖 AI Provider、模型任务、角色重置、记忆及音乐的已知错误；日记的旧格式错误标识列在 legacy_error，实际位于响应 error 字段。已知异步错误含 NO_SPEECH；DEVICE_INTERRUPTED.reason=vad_start 表示检测到语音开始，reason 保持可扩展。

不同业务的错误结构存在差异，不保证全部使用相同字段。先判断 HTTP 状态，再读取该接口的 code、message、reason 等；不要盲目重试写操作。

反馈时提供：设备软件版本、文档包 manifest.json 中的源码提交、发生时间及设备时区、HTTP 方法和路径、状态码、脱敏后的响应、相关 request_id / turn_id 和设备现象。不要发送 local_secret、凭据文件或签名请求头。

管理接口、调试音频、诊断日志和内部维护接口不属于本次对外契约。本文档包核对的是源码接口契约；工程编译、真实设备调用及云端完整链路需分别验证。

完整接口参考

所有路径已含 /v1/api。字段“必填”指其所属对象；oneOf 表示满足一个分支，anyOf 表示至少一个分支。空结构表示描述未限定结构，不能推断无字段。接口级响应之外仍可能由鉴权或权限中间件拒绝。

WebSocket

/v1/ws/chat/turns/{turn_id}/audio · Turn audio stream

Upload and receive audio for one conversation turn; disconnect ends an unfinished turn.

{
  "auth": "LocalHMAC query parameters on upgrade using actual path and empty-body hash; turn principal ownership required",
  "binary": "uint32 big-endian sequence from 1 followed by audio bytes; input pcm_s16le 16000 Hz mono, 2..3200 bytes per frame, 30 seconds maximum; output MP3, WAV or Ogg Opus as declared by audio.start, sample rate and channels from actual TTS metadata, at most 16384 audio bytes per frame",

GET /v1/api/auth/bootstrap

Get pre-pairing bootstrap information

ping only confirms HTTP availability. In bootstrap, language is the UI language, ai_language is the interaction language, and device_logged_in is the login flag. Pair with request → read the six-digit code on CODIE → confirm. challenge_id identifies that attempt; expires_at_ms is a Unix-millisecond deadline, not a duration. Cancel with the same challenge_id. Use credentials from confirm for signatures, not the displayed pairing code; keep sending a nonempty session ID when issued.

POST /v1/api/auth/pair/confirm

Confirm pairing and get credentials

auth_scope accepts session or permanent and defaults to permanent. Session credentials last 12 hours, expire on device service restart, and allow public user APIs; admin APIs require permanent credentials. Device capability policies still apply. Sign with local_secret and send local_session_id whenever it is nonempty. ping only confirms HTTP availability. In bootstrap, language is the UI language, ai_language is the interaction language, and device_logged_in is the login flag. Pair with request → read the six-digit code on CODIE → confirm. challenge_id identifies that attempt; expires_at_ms is a Unix-millisecond deadline, not a duration. Cancel with the same challenge_id. Use credentials from confirm for signatures, not the displayed pairing code; keep sending a nonempty session ID when issued.

POST /v1/api/auth/pair/request

Ask your CODE27 to show a pairing code

The device must be logged in. A pairing request lasts 5 minutes; the code is displayed on the device. When Origin or Referer is supplied, every supplied header must have the same hostname as the request, ignoring case and ports. Scripts and native apps may omit both. ping only confirms HTTP availability. In bootstrap, language is the UI language, ai_language is the interaction language, and device_logged_in is the login flag. Pair with request → read the six-digit code on CODIE → confirm. challenge_id identifies that attempt; expires_at_ms is a Unix-millisecond deadline, not a duration. Cancel with the same challenge_id. GET /v1/api/auth/ping

Check whether your CODE27 is online

ping only confirms HTTP availability. In bootstrap, language is the UI language, ai_language is the interaction language, and device_logged_in is the login flag. Pair with request → read the six-digit code on CODIE → confirm. challenge_id identifies that attempt; expires_at_ms is a Unix-millisecond deadline, not a duration. Cancel with the same challenge_id. Use credentials from confirm for signatures, not the displayed pairing code; keep sending a nonempty session ID when issued.

鉴权：无需签名 · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai-language

Get the conversation language

Choose ai_language from supported_languages returned by GET (currently en, zh, zh-TW, ja, fr, es, de, ko, it, pt); this does not set the UI language. Supported regional forms and case are normalized, e.g. en-US becomes en. Unsupported values return 400 INVALID_AI_LANGUAGE with supported_languages. Saving triggers existing language synchronization; it does not guarantee that an in-flight conversation changes language immediately.

GET /v1/api/data/user/device/brightness

Get main screen brightness

level is main screen brightness in percent, from 0 to 100. Zero is valid brightness and is not a software screen-off operation. A null level means unknown brightness; writable reports current host permission to write. Writes return saved and applied; actual level can differ slightly due to system 0–255 quantization. Secondary screen brightness is not controlled.

GET /v1/api/data/user/device/screen

Read screen power state

Reads both display channels; on is null when their states differ or the current state is unknown. Set requires a boolean on field. No key is sent if the target is already reached. The driver state is read after switching: 200 means a successful read or confirmed target, 409 means the switch was sent but not confirmed, and 503 indicates host, driver read, or key execution failure. SCREEN_READBACK_FAILED preserves command_sent=true and applied=false without returning stale driver readings. Available to all feature tags; pairing signatures remain required.

GET /v1/api/data/user/device/state

Get the screen-off, lock, and conversation blocking state

HTTP 200 means the state was read successfully, not that conversation is allowed. conversation_blocked is the current text-input admission decision; an interaction environment that is not ready or blocked content input can also cause rejection. When allowed, block_reason and display_key are omitted. Only an actual lock/screen-off gate rejection returns display_key=chat.error.device_blocked and block_reason=device_locked, screen_off, or device_locked_and_screen_off. Other rejections may have only block_reason; screen state alone does not determine display_key. game_mode and sub_mode are always strings, taken from the accepted device interaction snapshot when available, otherwise application state; they may be empty before synchronization. A main page can have an empty sub_mode (NONE is normalized to empty). LIVE, MUSIC, and other values describe the logical interaction route, not rendered-frame confirmation; tolerate new values. MODE_SWITCH and HORIZONTAL_LIST selectors can retain game_mode=MUSIC; use is_open from /data/user/music/page to determine whether the music page is open.

Read temporary media capabilities

Uploads stream to temporary files; resources are not persisted. Images, audio and video share session endpoints; images and video use percentage layouts. Omit max_duration_ms for no deadline. Audio and video play once unless loop is enabled. POST 202 means accepted; use GET for actual state. Temporary files are deleted on close, completion, replacement or user change.

GET /v1/api/data/user/media/sessions

Read temporary media sessions

Uploads stream to temporary files; resources are not persisted. Images, audio and video share session endpoints; images and video use percentage layouts. Omit max_duration_ms for no deadline. Audio and video play once unless loop is enabled. POST 202 means accepted; use GET for actual state. Temporary files are deleted on close, completion, replacement or user change.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

POST /v1/api/data/user/media/sessions

Upload and create a temporary media session

Uploads stream to temporary files; resources are not persisted. Images, audio and video share session endpoints; images and video use percentage layouts. Omit max_duration_ms for no deadline. Audio and video play once unless loop is enabled. POST 202 means accepted; use GET for actual state. Temporary files are deleted on close, completion, replacement or user change.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

POST /v1/api/data/user/media/sessions/{session_id}/actions

Control a temporary media session

Uploads stream to temporary files; resources are not persisted. Images, audio and video share session endpoints; images and video use percentage layouts. Omit max_duration_ms for no deadline. Audio and video play once unless loop is enabled. POST 202 means accepted; use GET for actual state. Temporary files are deleted on close, completion, replacement or user change.

GET /v1/api/data/user/system

Get basic device and current user information

language is the UI language; ai_language is the interaction language; timezone is the device time zone; use_24_hour_time is a display preference. capabilities is a map from capability identifiers to true/false for the current build/tag/user; use it and handle 403 CAPABILITY_REQUIRED instead of inferring permissions from firmware version. machine_id identifies the device, while user_id identifies the signed-in user. voice_audition_text is the fixed sample text for the current AI language.

GET /v1/api/data/user/tool-integrations

List external tool integrations

External tools are available to all models, including CODE27 and custom models. PUT replaces the entire catalog: create with expected_revision=0, update using the returned revision, and re-read after 409. protocol_version is v1; maximum 16 tools. enabled is registration state; online is connection state; neither proves execution. Connect the dedicated tool WebSocket; declarations are frozen for new chat sessions. idempotent and risk describe the application contract, not device-implemented deduplication.

角色与主动交互 · 34 个操作

GET /v1/api/data/user/character

Get character settings

If slot is omitted, slot 1 is queried. cloud_id is the character ID; if the local cloud character mapping is missing, the current implementation tries to resolve it from the cloud. link_other_original_cloth uses fixed positions by outfit number: the Nth comma-separated segment corresponds to cloth_number=N, independently of the order in available_cloths. Each slot:cloth specifies a source slot and outfit number, without following its current selected_cloth. For example, 2:2,,1:1 links outfit 1 to slot 2, outfit 2; outfit 2 has no link; outfit 3 links to slot 1, outfit 1. Preserve empty segments in the middle. An entirely empty string means no links. A custom model for the corresponding outfit takes priority. Use the character list to discover slots and settings; reading another slot does not select it. Attribute PUT is partial: absent or null attributes are unchanged, while explicit empty strings still undergo business validation. Omitted/zero slot_number selects the current slot. Choose voice_id and group_key together from the voice catalog. tts_volume is 0–100, controlled separately from music volume. basic_info_locked, prompt_locked, and voice_locked indicate locked settings; dlc_available indicates DLC availability. dlc_source_slot is not the local slot number.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

PUT /v1/api/data/user/character

Update character settings incrementally

Only the character settings included in the request are changed. If slot_number is omitted or 0, the current slot is used. Outfit fields must be submitted to /data/user/character/outfit/apply; otherwise OUTFIT_APPLY_REQUIRED is returned. Use the character list to discover slots and settings; reading another slot does not select it. Attribute PUT is partial: absent or null attributes are unchanged, while explicit empty strings still undergo business validation. Omitted/zero slot_number selects the current slot. Choose voice_id and group_key together from the voice catalog. tts_volume is 0–100, controlled separately from music volume. basic_info_locked, prompt_locked, and voice_locked indicate locked settings; dlc_available indicates DLC availability. dlc_source_slot is not the local slot number.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/character/loading/state

Get the character model loading state

state is the reported loading-state string; is_loading is true only for LOADING_STATE_START. updated_at_ms is the state timestamp. false alone does not prove success: there may be no report yet or a failure. Also inspect state and loading, load_error, load_generation from /character/model.

GET /v1/api/data/user/character/model

Read current model size and shape controls

Read the current model first, then send that snapshot's slot_number, cloth_number, load_generation; stale requests after a switch return 409 MODEL_CHANGED. Height is in meters (0.7–2.4); morph values are 0–1. preview does not persist; commit does. reset_category/reset_all apply only to morphs; reset_all excludes height. Reuse the returned ref; semantic=0 also requires node_name. height_snapshot_version and morph_snapshot_version track the respective Display reports, separately from overall version. Reset acceptance does not mean the new snapshot has arrived.

POST /v1/api/data/user/character/model/control

Preview, save or reset the current model controls

Read the current model first, then send that snapshot's slot_number, cloth_number, load_generation; stale requests after a switch return 409 MODEL_CHANGED. Height is in meters (0.7–2.4); morph values are 0–1. preview does not persist; commit does. reset_category/reset_all apply only to morphs; reset_all excludes height. Reuse the returned ref; semantic=0 also requires node_name. height_snapshot_version and morph_snapshot_version track the respective Display reports, separately from overall version. Reset acceptance does not mean the new snapshot has arrived.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/character/outfit/apply

Commit the model draft and apply an outfit

Commits the model draft in the slot and applies the outfit, which may involve compression and memory checks. available_cloths is a comma-separated list of outfit IDs. link_other_original_cloth uses fixed positions by outfit number: the Nth comma-separated segment corresponds to cloth_number=N, independently of the order in available_cloths. Each slot:cloth specifies a source slot and outfit number, without following its current selected_cloth. For example, 2:2,,1:1 links outfit 1 to slot 2, outfit 2; outfit 2 has no link; outfit 3 links to slot 1, outfit 1. Preserve empty segments in the middle. An entirely empty string means no links. A custom model for the corresponding outfit takes priority. After an upload completes, the model must still be applied; check the loading result with /character/loading/state. Returns 409 while an upload is active or a character is loading.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/character/reset

Start a full reset of the current character

Call /character/reset/authorize first to get operation_id and reauth_token, then start a full reset of the current character. 202 means accepted; poll /character/reset/status. The existing additional identity verification still applies. This fully resets the current character. authorize checks the signed-in account's username/password without switching users. Pass its operation_id and reauth_token unchanged to start; they are not interchangeable. Query status by operation_id or active for the active task. phase identifies the stage, error_code the failure, and retryable a retry hint, not permission to bypass authorization. 202 is not reset completion. Current phases are CLOUD_PENDING, LOCAL_DB_PENDING, LOCAL_FILES_PENDING, DISPLAY_PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED_CLOUD; only COMPLETED indicates completion.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/cloth/download/async

Export the applied custom model asynchronously

Exports the currently applied custom model. After you get the task ID, poll /cloth/download/status and download the result once it succeeds. A new task for the same slot and outfit cancels the previous one, and completed tasks are kept for 30 minutes. created_at, started_at, and ended_at use Unix milliseconds. The exported ZIP contains the currently cached, applied custom model and an available portrait; it is not guaranteed to be byte-identical to the original upload. job_id identifies an upload/export task; query its own status with that ID. Successful upload saves a draft, not an applied model; use /character/outfit/apply and inspect /cloth/drafts for drafts. identity uses multipart file; gzip/zstd uses independent compressed chunks numbered consecutively from 0, then complete. Do not automatically resend accepted chunks. Export with async → status → binary result, signing every step; download_path is not a public unsigned URL. Upload states are PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELED. created_at, started_at, ended_at are Unix milliseconds despite having no _ms suffix.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/cloth/model

Delete a user model and its associated assets

Deletes the draft, final model, legacy display assets, and portrait for the specified slot and outfit, and clears the custom model binding. Runs serially with model application; returns 409 while an upload is active or a character is loading. job_id identifies an upload/export task; query its own status with that ID. Successful upload saves a draft, not an applied model; use /character/outfit/apply and inspect /cloth/drafts for drafts. identity uses multipart file; gzip/zstd uses independent compressed chunks numbered consecutively from 0, then complete. Do not automatically resend accepted chunks. Export with async → status → binary result, signing every step; download_path is not a public unsigned URL. Upload states are PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELED. created_at, started_at, ended_at are Unix milliseconds despite having no _ms suffix.

POST /v1/api/data/user/cloth/upload/job

Create a model upload task

transport_encoding defaults to identity; zstd or gzip are also supported. Compressed uploads require original_size_bytes, and the uncompressed model limit is 200 MiB. A new task for the same slot and outfit cancels the previous one. Tasks are bound to the user who created them, and waiting, receiving, and processing share one 5-minute deadline. Cancel with DELETE /cloth/upload/job/{job_id}. job_id identifies an upload/export task; query its own status with that ID. Successful upload saves a draft, not an applied model; use /character/outfit/apply and inspect /cloth/drafts for drafts. identity uses multipart file; gzip/zstd uses independent compressed chunks numbered consecutively from 0, then complete. Do not automatically resend accepted chunks. Export with async → status → binary result, signing every step; download_path is not a public unsigned URL. Upload states are PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELED. created_at, started_at, ended_at are Unix milliseconds despite having no _ms suffix.

POST /v1/api/data/user/cloth/upload/job/{job_id}/chunk/{sequence}

Upload a compressed model chunk

sequence starts at 0 and increases by one with each chunk; each chunk is an independent gzip or zstd compressed frame. The payload mode is gzip-stream or zstd-stream, and the body hash is the SHA-256 of the exact compressed bytes. Each chunk is limited to 8 MiB in transit, and duplicate chunks aren't retried automatically. job_id identifies an upload/export task; query its own status with that ID. Successful upload saves a draft, not an applied model; use /character/outfit/apply and inspect /cloth/drafts for drafts. identity uses multipart file; gzip/zstd uses independent compressed chunks numbered consecutively from 0, then complete. Do not automatically resend accepted chunks. Export with async → status → binary result, signing every step; download_path is not a public unsigned URL. Upload states are PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELED. created_at, started_at, ended_at are Unix milliseconds despite having no _ms suffix.

POST /v1/api/data/user/cloth/upload/job/{job_id}/complete

Complete a chunked upload and validate the model

Send an empty body with the matching gzip-stream or zstd-stream mode; the body hash is the SHA-256 of empty bytes. Model processing starts only after all the bytes declared in original_size_bytes have been received. job_id identifies an upload/export task; query its own status with that ID. Successful upload saves a draft, not an applied model; use /character/outfit/apply and inspect /cloth/drafts for drafts. identity uses multipart file; gzip/zstd uses independent compressed chunks numbered consecutively from 0, then complete. Do not automatically resend accepted chunks. Export with async → status → binary result, signing every step; download_path is not a public unsigned URL. Upload states are PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELED. created_at, started_at, ended_at are Unix milliseconds despite having no _ms suffix.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/proactive/config

Get proactive conversation settings

PUT config replaces the entire configuration rather than merging nested fields. GET first and submit complete enabled, triggers, inhibitors, runtime; omitted booleans can become false. Triggers cover greetings, idle recovery, outfit/character changes, smile/proximity/gesture; inhibitors cover quiet hours and darkness. Enabling does not force immediate conversation. Seconds: ordinary trigger cooldown 0–86400, visual cooldown 3–3600, idle threshold 60–86400. Window starts are 0–23, ends 0–24; greeting start must precede end. Preserve advanced runtime values from GET; some values normalize, so use the response. In runtime, cooldown_enabled/state_inhibitor_enabled control cooldown/state inhibition. fallback_cooldown_seconds is fallback cooldown (0–86400), time_check_interval_seconds is time-trigger polling (60–3600), idle_check_interval_seconds is idle polling (60–7200). Normalized luminance thresholds are 10–120; saving synchronizes vision_dark_frame_luma_threshold to luma_threshold. vision_confirm_frames is 2–4. vision_smile_min_frame_score is 0.4–0.9, vision_smile_confirm_avg_score 0.5–0.95 and >= the minimum. vision_proximity_min_face_ratio is 0.05–0.3, vision_proximity_rearm_face_ratio 0.08–0.35 and >= the minimum; vision_proximity_min_ratio_delta is 0.04–0.3, vision_proximity_min_ratio_growth 1.1–3. vision_gesture_score_threshold_low/mid/high are respectively 0.5–0.9, 0.55–0.95, 0.6–0.98 and require low<=mid<=high.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/slot

Get the current character slot and outfit

GET returns current slot_number, selected_cloth, and outfit-context version. PUT takes only slot_number and triggers the existing character switch; it does not edit settings or outfit sources. After success, check /character/loading/state and re-read slot/model state; PUT success alone is not proof that the model is displayed. The current version string is slot:cloth (e.g. 1:2), not a monotonic revision; do not confuse it with model load_generation or numeric snapshot versions.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

路径、查询及请求头参数
位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

无已声明的请求正文；签名和具体调用要求见上述说明。

模型服务 · 16 个操作

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai/about-me

Get the current user's About me

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

POST /v1/api/data/user/ai/architecture

Switch conversation architecture

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

POST /v1/api/data/user/ai/backend/switch

Switch the model service backend

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PUT /v1/api/data/user/ai/capability-routes/{capability}

Update capability routing settings

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai/provider-errors/latest

Get the latest provider runtime error

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai/provider-profiles

List provider profiles

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/ai/provider-profiles/{id}

Delete a provider profile

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}
pathid是 {"type": "string"}

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PUT /v1/api/data/user/ai/provider-profiles/{id}

Update a provider profile

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}
pathid是 {"type": "string"}

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

POST /v1/api/data/user/ai/provider-profiles/{id}/test

Test a provider connection

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}
pathid是 {"type": "string"}

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai/providers/catalog

Get the provider catalog

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

路径、查询及请求头参数
位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

无已声明的请求正文；签名和具体调用要求见上述说明。

GET /v1/api/data/user/ai/system-prompt

Get global system prompt

Use providers/catalog to select providers, capabilities and protocols; take models and voices from the profile connection test. api_key is write-only and credential_ref is server managed. Verify a new profile with /provider-profiles/:id/test; key replacement validates before saving and preserves the old key on failure. options is a JSON object and overrides options_json when supplied; supported parameters and limits come from catalog route_options. Active conversations can block configuration changes with 409; switching to local_harness also requires ready profiles and routes for the current architecture. Save architecture and backend separately. provider-errors/latest returns data=null when absent; runtime error codes may be extended by providers.

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/chat/history

Clear the current user's chat history and debug artifacts

Paged GET requires slot (1–5); limit defaults to 50, maximum 100; direction is older (default) or newer. Treat cursor/next_cursor as opaque and follow has_more. date uses YYYY-MM-DD and is mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date; ranges require both endpoints. chat_id identifies one history item, turn_id a turn; group_chat_id is not turn_id. user_chat_ids identify user records, not assistant replies. Deletion also synchronizes runtime context; delete individual records by chat_id. limit counts turns, while items contains all messages in those turns and may exceed limit; items are always ordered by ascending message key. Dates use the device time zone and each turn's earliest message, so a turn spanning midnight is not split.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/chat/history

Get chat history by slot, date filters, and cursor

slot is 1 to 5. date can't be combined with start_date and end_date; a date range needs both values, and the start can't be later than the end. Dates use the device timezone. Without dates, the whole slot is queried. direction defaults to older, paging from the newest turn into the past; newer pages from the earliest turn forward. For cursor, use next_cursor from the previous page with the same filters and direction. Records within a page are always in ascending message ID order, and the response returns items, next_cursor, and has_more. limit defaults to 50, up to 100, and counts logical turns, so image and text records from the same turn are never split across pages. A turn's date and cursor come from its earliest message, and related records that span days or interleave are still returned complete; reuse next_cursor as is. Paged GET requires slot (1–5); limit defaults to 50, maximum 100; direction is older (default) or newer. Treat cursor/next_cursor as opaque and follow has_more. date uses YYYY-MM-DD and is mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date; ranges require both endpoints. chat_id identifies one history item, turn_id a turn; group_chat_id is not turn_id. user_chat_ids identify user records, not assistant replies. Deletion also synchronizes runtime context; delete individual records by chat_id. limit counts turns, while items contains all messages in those turns and may exceed limit; items are always ordered by ascending message key. Dates use the device time zone and each turn's earliest message, so a turn spanning midnight is not split.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/chat/history/items

Delete selected chat records

chat_ids are deduplicated and limited to 500, and slot_number must be 1 to 5. The selected messages and their related turns must all belong to that slot; otherwise 409 SLOT_MISMATCH is returned. local_deleted and deleted_chat_ids come from what was actually deleted in the transaction and may be fewer or more than the requested IDs. Paged GET requires slot (1–5); limit defaults to 50, maximum 100; direction is older (default) or newer. Treat cursor/next_cursor as opaque and follow has_more. date uses YYYY-MM-DD and is mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date; ranges require both endpoints. chat_id identifies one history item, turn_id a turn; group_chat_id is not turn_id. user_chat_ids identify user records, not assistant replies. Deletion also synchronizes runtime context; delete individual records by chat_id. limit counts turns, while items contains all messages in those turns and may exceed limit; items are always ordered by ascending message key. Dates use the device time zone and each turn's earliest message, so a turn spanning midnight is not split.

POST /v1/api/data/user/chat/turns

Create a conversation turn with input and output settings

request_id, slot, input, and output are required. input.type supports text, image_text, device_microphone, audio_file, and audio_stream; output.speech supports none, device, and client. Text, device recording, and audio streams use JSON; images and WAV use multipart. audio_stream requires little-endian PCM16, 16 kHz, mono, and audio.container=raw. For stream input or client output, connect to the turn’s /v1/ws/chat/turns/<turn_id>/audio WebSocket with a signed GET within 15 seconds of creation and wait for ready before sending audio. Client output uses MP3, WAV, or Ogg Opus according to the actual TTS metadata; after audio.end, acknowledge the final sequence before the turn can complete. Disconnecting ends the turn; resuming or replaying audio after reconnecting is unsupported. Files are limited to 1 MiB; WAV and stream input are limited to 30 seconds. slot must be the current slot, and existing conversation admission rules apply. 202 only means accepted. Retries with the same credentials, request_id, and request content reuse the original turn; conflicting content returns 409. Up to 256 turns are kept for 30 minutes after reaching a terminal state; idempotency records are lost on restart. input/complete and cancel use empty bodies to end recording or stream input and cancel the whole turn, respectively. When retention is not none, text and image-with-text input save the user message before acceptance; user_chat_ids contains the saved IDs. Microphone, WAV, and stream IDs may appear after transcription. interrupt defaults to true; false fails the turn with DEVICE_BUSY when the device is busy and retracts any user records written for this turn. retention defaults to full: save chat and update conversation state, summaries, long-term memory, and diaries; chat saves chat only; none saves neither chat nor images and makes none of those updates, leaving both chat_ids arrays empty. All modes read existing history and memory; the turn itself remains temporarily in memory. Turn resources are visible only to their creating pairing credentials. turn_id is the server task ID; request_id is the client idempotency key. Inspect state/error and version; completed, failed, cancelled are terminal. Device output waits for playback completion; client output requires acknowledging the final audio sequence. input/complete ends input only; cancel cancels the whole turn. Restart/expiry invalidates old task and deduplication assumptions. Task retention is separate from persistent chat history. state values: queued, starting, receiving_input, thinking, responding, cancelling, completed, failed, cancelled. device_microphone automatically ends input after at most 30 seconds. input_complete does not mean the turn has finished; transcript may appear before a terminal state. DEVICE_INTERRUPTED reason identifies the interruption source, for example vad_start (speech start detected). It is an extensible string, not a closed enum.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}

Get a conversation turn

Turn resources are visible only to their creating pairing credentials. turn_id is the server task ID; request_id is the client idempotency key. Inspect state/error and version; completed, failed, cancelled are terminal. Device output waits for playback completion; client output requires acknowledging the final audio sequence. input/complete ends input only; cancel cancels the whole turn. Restart/expiry invalidates old task and deduplication assumptions. Task retention is separate from persistent chat history. state values: queued, starting, receiving_input, thinking, responding, cancelling, completed, failed, cancelled. device_microphone automatically ends input after at most 30 seconds. input_complete does not mean the turn has finished; transcript may appear before a terminal state. DEVICE_INTERRUPTED reason identifies the interruption source, for example vad_start (speech start detected). It is an extensible string, not a closed enum.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}/cancel

Cancel a conversation turn

Turn resources are visible only to their creating pairing credentials. turn_id is the server task ID; request_id is the client idempotency key. Inspect state/error and version; completed, failed, cancelled are terminal. Device output waits for playback completion; client output requires acknowledging the final audio sequence. input/complete ends input only; cancel cancels the whole turn. Restart/expiry invalidates old task and deduplication assumptions. Task retention is separate from persistent chat history. state values: queued, starting, receiving_input, thinking, responding, cancelling, completed, failed, cancelled. device_microphone automatically ends input after at most 30 seconds. input_complete does not mean the turn has finished; transcript may appear before a terminal state. DEVICE_INTERRUPTED reason identifies the interruption source, for example vad_start (speech start detected). It is an extensible string, not a closed enum.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}
pathturn_id是 {"description": "Server chat-turn ID for query/input completion/cancel/stream, distinct from chat_id.", "type": "string"}

POST /v1/api/data/user/chat/turns/{turn_id}/input/complete

End recording or audio stream input for a turn

Turn resources are visible only to their creating pairing credentials. turn_id is the server task ID; request_id is the client idempotency key. Inspect state/error and version; completed, failed, cancelled are terminal. Device output waits for playback completion; client output requires acknowledging the final audio sequence. input/complete ends input only; cancel cancels the whole turn. Restart/expiry invalidates old task and deduplication assumptions. Task retention is separate from persistent chat history. state values: queued, starting, receiving_input, thinking, responding, cancelling, completed, failed, cancelled. device_microphone automatically ends input after at most 30 seconds. input_complete does not mean the turn has finished; transcript may appear before a terminal state. DEVICE_INTERRUPTED reason identifies the interruption source, for example vad_start (speech start detected). It is an extensible string, not a closed enum.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/resources/user/chat-images

Get a chat image for the current user

uuid must be the complete image ID; prefixes aren't accepted. Only a file with the same ID in the current user's chat image folder is matched. Resource requests still require pairing signatures; success may return image bytes rather than JSON. Obtain paths from the corresponding catalog/manifest instead of constructing internal storage paths; missing resources return 404. chat-images uuid identifies an image, not chat_id. Prefer /data/user/character/outfit/thumbnail?slot_number=...&cloth_number=... for custom outfit previews.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

记忆与日记 · 8 个操作

GET /v1/api/data/user/diary/entries

List character diary entries by page

page starts at 1; pageSize defaults to 20, up to 100. Date merging, status filtering, and pagination happen in the database; total is the full count, and out-of-range pages return empty entries. Invalid parameters return 400. Diary operations use local storage. Listing requires slot and characterId; item read/update/delete also requires characterId. date is YYYY-MM-DD; includeDeleted or status=deleted includes deleted items. Responses use entries, total, page, pageSize, totalPages, unlike memory pagination. PUT is partial: provide title and/or content, with nonblank content when supplied. Delete is local soft deletion. operation_id traces this write and changed_fields lists its fields; it is not an async task ID. source_*, trigger_*, memory_grounding_ratio, imagination_ratio, generated_by_* describe generation provenance or scoring. visibility/status/favorite/reaction and revision/sync_id/tombstone are returned state/sync metadata; this update endpoint only supports title/content. created_at/updated_at are RFC3339 strings, empty for a zero timestamp. Deletion clears title, preview and content; reading a deleted ID returns 404. Saving unchanged content does not set the user-edited flag or update the timestamp. Only title/content are accepted. Unknown fields return 400 with error=invalid_body and a detail identifying the invalid field. revision is synchronization metadata, not an edit counter.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/diary/entries/{entryId}

Delete a diary entry

Diary operations use local storage. Listing requires slot and characterId; item read/update/delete also requires characterId. date is YYYY-MM-DD; includeDeleted or status=deleted includes deleted items. Responses use entries, total, page, pageSize, totalPages, unlike memory pagination. PUT is partial: provide title and/or content, with nonblank content when supplied. Delete is local soft deletion. operation_id traces this write and changed_fields lists its fields; it is not an async task ID. source_*, trigger_*, memory_grounding_ratio, imagination_ratio, generated_by_* describe generation provenance or scoring. visibility/status/favorite/reaction and revision/sync_id/tombstone are returned state/sync metadata; this update endpoint only supports title/content. created_at/updated_at are RFC3339 strings, empty for a zero timestamp. Deletion clears title, preview and content; reading a deleted ID returns 404. Saving unchanged content does not set the user-edited flag or update the timestamp. Only title/content are accepted. Unknown fields return 400 with error=invalid_body and a detail identifying the invalid field. revision is synchronization metadata, not an edit counter.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

  ],

    "invalid_content"
  ]
}

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PUT /v1/api/data/user/diary/entries/{entryId}

Update a diary entry

Diary operations use local storage. Listing requires slot and characterId; item read/update/delete also requires characterId. date is YYYY-MM-DD; includeDeleted or status=deleted includes deleted items. Responses use entries, total, page, pageSize, totalPages, unlike memory pagination. PUT is partial: provide title and/or content, with nonblank content when supplied. Delete is local soft deletion. operation_id traces this write and changed_fields lists its fields; it is not an async task ID. source_*, trigger_*, memory_grounding_ratio, imagination_ratio, generated_by_* describe generation provenance or scoring. visibility/status/favorite/reaction and revision/sync_id/tombstone are returned state/sync metadata; this update endpoint only supports title/content. created_at/updated_at are RFC3339 strings, empty for a zero timestamp. Deletion clears title, preview and content; reading a deleted ID returns 404. Saving unchanged content does not set the user-edited flag or update the timestamp. Only title/content are accepted. Unknown fields return 400 with error=invalid_body and a detail identifying the invalid field. revision is synchronization metadata, not an edit counter.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/memory/cards

Memory operations use the current user's local store and require characterId (character identity, not slot number). page starts at 1; pageSize defaults to 20, max 100. HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

闹钟与备忘录 · 11 个操作

POST /v1/api/data/user/alarm

Create an alarm

Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. POST creation and PUT replacement require an alarm wrapper and all fields: enabled, label, tag, hour, minute, repeat_mask, ringtone, snooze_minutes, snooze_enabled, snooze_max_count. Fields cannot be omitted or null. Explicit false, 0 and empty strings count as present but must pass business validation. GET the current record, edit writable fields and send the complete configuration. PUT uses the URL ID. To change only enabled, send PATCH with a JSON body containing only the boolean enabled field (true or false), without the alarm wrapper. hour is 0–23 and minute 0–59, in the device time zone. repeat_mask uses Sunday–Saturday bits 1,2,4,8,16,32,64; combine by addition, with 0 for once and 127 for daily. Ringtones: ringtone_default, ringtone_soft, ringtone_nature. snooze_minutes is minutes (nonpositive becomes 10); snooze_max_count nonpositive becomes 3. Disable snooze with snooze_enabled=false, not zero. Updating clears the current snooze deadline. next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms, snooze_until_ms are read-only Unix-millisecond runtime values; zero means no corresponding time. Deleting or disabling stops the current ringing instance. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code and can be retried.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

DELETE /v1/api/data/user/alarm/{alarmId}

Delete an alarm

hour is 0–23 and minute 0–59, in the device time zone. repeat_mask uses Sunday–Saturday bits 1,2,4,8,16,32,64; combine by addition, with 0 for once and 127 for daily. Ringtones: ringtone_default, ringtone_soft, ringtone_nature. snooze_minutes is minutes (nonpositive becomes 10); snooze_max_count nonpositive becomes 3. Disable snooze with snooze_enabled=false, not zero. Updating clears the current snooze deadline. next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms, snooze_until_ms are read-only Unix-millisecond runtime values; zero means no corresponding time. Deleting or disabling stops the current ringing instance. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code and can be retried.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PATCH /v1/api/data/user/alarm/{alarmId}

Update an alarm's enabled state

The body is the enabled boolean; false disables the alarm, and the field can't be omitted or null. Only the enabled state can be changed; including other fields returns 400. Use PUT to update the full alarm. hour is 0–23 and minute 0–59, in the device time zone. repeat_mask uses Sunday–Saturday bits 1,2,4,8,16,32,64; combine by addition, with 0 for once and 127 for daily. Ringtones: ringtone_default, ringtone_soft, ringtone_nature. snooze_minutes is minutes (nonpositive becomes 10); snooze_max_count nonpositive becomes 3. Disable snooze with snooze_enabled=false, not zero. Updating clears the current snooze deadline. next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms, snooze_until_ms are read-only Unix-millisecond runtime values; zero means no corresponding time. Deleting or disabling stops the current ringing instance. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code and can be retried.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

HTTP 503 · Service Unavailable

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PUT /v1/api/data/user/alarm/{alarmId}

Update an alarm

Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. POST creation and PUT replacement require an alarm wrapper and all fields: enabled, label, tag, hour, minute, repeat_mask, ringtone, snooze_minutes, snooze_enabled, snooze_max_count. Fields cannot be omitted or null. Explicit false, 0 and empty strings count as present but must pass business validation. GET the current record, edit writable fields and send the complete configuration. PUT uses the URL ID. To change only enabled, send PATCH with a JSON body containing only the boolean enabled field (true or false), without the alarm wrapper. hour is 0–23 and minute 0–59, in the device time zone. repeat_mask uses Sunday–Saturday bits 1,2,4,8,16,32,64; combine by addition, with 0 for once and 127 for daily. Ringtones: ringtone_default, ringtone_soft, ringtone_nature. snooze_minutes is minutes (nonpositive becomes 10); snooze_max_count nonpositive becomes 3. Disable snooze with snooze_enabled=false, not zero. Updating clears the current snooze deadline. next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms, snooze_until_ms are read-only Unix-millisecond runtime values; zero means no corresponding time. Deleting or disabling stops the current ringing instance. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code and can be retried.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

GET /v1/api/data/user/memos

List notes and reminders

memo_type is static or reminder. schedule_type supports none, once_at, every_n_days, monthly, yearly; choose explicitly for reminders instead of relying on inference. once_at must be in the future. every_n_days uses interval_days (effective 1–15; nonpositive retains/defaults to 1, above 15 becomes 15). Invalid monthly/yearly day-of-month is clamped to month end. hour/minute are 0–23/0–59; timezone is the reminder time zone. Scheduling can rewrite repeat_mask: once_at=0, every_n_days=127. is_expired, expired_at, content_version, next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms are server state, not writable fields. Saving recalculates scheduling. Deleting or converting to a plain note stops the current reminder. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code. Reminders due during an alarm are deferred.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

POST /v1/api/data/user/memos

Create a note or reminder

Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. POST creation and PUT replacement require a memo wrapper and all fields: title, body, memo_type, schedule_type, interval_days, trigger_year, trigger_month, trigger_day, hour, minute, timezone, ringtone. Include every field even when unused by the current type; omission or null is rejected. Zero and empty strings must still pass business validation. GET the current record, edit writable fields and send the complete configuration. PUT uses the URL ID. repeat_mask is optional; clients using it should send its current value because omission is treated as 0. Partial updates are not supported. memo_type is static or reminder. schedule_type supports none, once_at, every_n_days, monthly, yearly; choose explicitly for reminders instead of relying on inference. once_at must be in the future. every_n_days uses interval_days (effective 1–15; nonpositive retains/defaults to 1, above 15 becomes 15). Invalid monthly/yearly day-of-month is clamped to month end. hour/minute are 0–23/0–59; timezone is the reminder time zone. Scheduling can rewrite repeat_mask: once_at=0, every_n_days=127. is_expired, expired_at, content_version, next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms are server state, not writable fields. Saving recalculates scheduling. Deleting or converting to a plain note stops the current reminder. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code. Reminders due during an alarm are deferred.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/memos/{memoId}

Get a note or reminder

memo_type is static or reminder. schedule_type supports none, once_at, every_n_days, monthly, yearly; choose explicitly for reminders instead of relying on inference. once_at must be in the future. every_n_days uses interval_days (effective 1–15; nonpositive retains/defaults to 1, above 15 becomes 15). Invalid monthly/yearly day-of-month is clamped to month end. hour/minute are 0–23/0–59; timezone is the reminder time zone. Scheduling can rewrite repeat_mask: once_at=0, every_n_days=127. is_expired, expired_at, content_version, next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms are server state, not writable fields. Saving recalculates scheduling. Deleting or converting to a plain note stops the current reminder. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code. Reminders due during an alarm are deferred.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

PUT /v1/api/data/user/memos/{memoId}

Update a note or reminder

Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. POST creation and PUT replacement require a memo wrapper and all fields: title, body, memo_type, schedule_type, interval_days, trigger_year, trigger_month, trigger_day, hour, minute, timezone, ringtone. Include every field even when unused by the current type; omission or null is rejected. Zero and empty strings must still pass business validation. GET the current record, edit writable fields and send the complete configuration. PUT uses the URL ID. repeat_mask is optional; clients using it should send its current value because omission is treated as 0. Partial updates are not supported. memo_type is static or reminder. schedule_type supports none, once_at, every_n_days, monthly, yearly; choose explicitly for reminders instead of relying on inference. once_at must be in the future. every_n_days uses interval_days (effective 1–15; nonpositive retains/defaults to 1, above 15 becomes 15). Invalid monthly/yearly day-of-month is clamped to month end. hour/minute are 0–23/0–59; timezone is the reminder time zone. Scheduling can rewrite repeat_mask: once_at=0, every_n_days=127. is_expired, expired_at, content_version, next_fire_at_ms, last_fired_at_ms are server state, not writable fields. Saving recalculates scheduling. Deleting or converting to a plain note stops the current reminder. Unconfirmed host execution returns 503 with a REMINDER_* code. Reminders due during an alarm are deferred.

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/audio-route

Get the music audio output route

route is SPEAKER, WIRED_HEADSET, or UNKNOWN; wired_headset is the wired-headset flag. This is an output-route snapshot, not Bluetooth input-source state, and provides no route-switch operation. UNKNOWN means undetermined, not muted.

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/bluetooth

Get the Bluetooth connection state

is_bluetooth_enabled and is_connected describe different facts. paired_devices lists paired devices, not scan results; paired_device_count is not the simultaneous connection count. Forget requires a six-byte MAC device_address and optional request_id (generated if omitted). 202 only accepts the command; correlate the Bluetooth snapshot's operation by request_id to determine whether unpairing finished.
