POST /v1/api/data/user/music/control

Send a music control command

Actions: PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, PREVIOUS, NEXT, SELECT_TRACK, QUERY_STATE, SEEK, SET_VOLUME, SET_PLAY_MODE, SET_SOUND_EFFECT and EDIT_QUEUE. The JSON body is limited to 1 MiB. source is LOCAL_TF; switch Bluetooth through /music/source. queue is allowed only with PLAY, SELECT_TRACK or EDIT_QUEUE and requires expected_queue_revision. EDIT_QUEUE replaces the current queue, without editing saved playlists or TF files. Clearing stops playback; removing a playing entry advances; editing while paused does not start playback. The device music page must be open except for QUERY_STATE, SET_VOLUME and SET_SOUND_EFFECT; otherwise HTTP 409 MODE_INACTIVE is returned. HTTP 200 means queued only. Match request_id in /music/playback or music_playback and inspect applied, error_code and the actual state. QUEUE_CONFLICT is an asynchronous execution result, not this endpoint's HTTP 409. request_id does not deduplicate commands. STOP clears the current track and retains the queue. volume_level uses normalized 0–100 volume; volume_max is 100 when the device is ready. SEEK accepts progress_ms (milliseconds) or progress_ratio (0–1); send one. play_mode is sequence (repeat the queue in order), single_loop or shuffle; sound_effect is classical, surround or vocal. SELECT_TRACK accepts track_id or queue_entry_id; the entry ID takes precedence if both are sent. SELECT_TRACK with track_id and without queue or queue_entry_id installs the track's folder as the current queue. Use queue_entry_id to select within the existing queue. PLAY without a target resumes the current entry; an empty queue may be initialized from device files. The queue is an independent playback snapshot; later saved-playlist edits do not change it. status is IDLE, LOADING, PLAYING, PAUSED, COMPLETED or FAILED. version tracks snapshot changes and music_session_version tracks playback sessions; both are runtime values. applied confirms device execution, not a rendered frame. Natural completion is also sent as music_track_ended; polling can miss transient COMPLETED snapshots.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

Setting it does not switch pages. saved reports persistence; display_command_sent confirms acceptance by the Display output queue; render_confirmed=false does not confirm rendering. Dispatch failure returns 503 with display_command_sent=false and preserves saved=true if persistence succeeded.

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/library

Read music playlists

Saved playlists belong to the current account and are shared across clients, separately from TF files and the current queue. PUT replaces playlists in full and requires the revision read by GET as expected_revision. Conflicts return HTTP 409, LIBRARY_CONFLICT and the latest library in data; reread before editing. Bodies are limited to 4 MiB, with at most 100 playlists and 1000 track references per playlist. Each id is nonempty, unique and at most 100 UTF-8 bytes. Trimmed names contain 1–80 characters; storage_root is nonempty. track_ids use local: plus an absolute path, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes each; missing tracks may remain referenced. Omitted or null track_ids becomes an empty list. Removing playlists or references neither deletes TF files nor changes an existing playback queue snapshot. On save, duplicate track references within each playlist are removed, preserving first occurrence order; files with the same name at different paths remain distinct. Reads do not normalize existing duplicates, and the current playback queue still allows repeated entries.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/playback

Get the music playback state

volume_level uses normalized 0–100 volume; volume_max is 100 when the device is ready. SEEK accepts progress_ms (milliseconds) or progress_ratio (0–1); send one. play_mode is sequence (repeat the queue in order), single_loop or shuffle; sound_effect is classical, surround or vocal. SELECT_TRACK accepts track_id or queue_entry_id; the entry ID takes precedence if both are sent. SELECT_TRACK with track_id and without queue or queue_entry_id installs the track's folder as the current queue. Use queue_entry_id to select within the existing queue. PLAY without a target resumes the current entry; an empty queue may be initialized from device files. The queue is an independent playback snapshot; later saved-playlist edits do not change it. status is IDLE, LOADING, PLAYING, PAUSED, COMPLETED or FAILED. version tracks snapshot changes and music_session_version tracks playback sessions; both are runtime values. applied confirms device execution, not a rendered frame. Natural completion is also sent as music_track_ended; polling can miss transient COMPLETED snapshots.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/source

Get the current music source

source supports LOCAL_TF and BLUETOOTH; it selects input source, not the Character/Music page. Before source reports arrive, the default depends on TF-card availability and does not prove active playback. POST may return snapshot.is_applying=true; track request_id, is_applying, error_code and subsequent snapshots. An omitted request_id is generated. music_session_id and version are runtime identifiers, not a persistent playlist. origin is ANDROID, WEB, DEFAULT, or RECOVERY and identifies how the source state arose, not playback permission. Open the music page before switching sources; otherwise the request returns 409 MUSIC_MODE_INACTIVE.

POST /v1/api/data/user/music/source

Switch the music source

source supports LOCAL_TF and BLUETOOTH; it selects input source, not the Character/Music page. Before source reports arrive, the default depends on TF-card availability and does not prove active playback. POST may return snapshot.is_applying=true; track request_id, is_applying, error_code and subsequent snapshots. An omitted request_id is generated. music_session_id and version are runtime identifiers, not a persistent playlist. origin is ANDROID, WEB, DEFAULT, or RECOVERY and identifies how the source state arose, not playback permission. Open the music page before switching sources; otherwise the request returns 409 MUSIC_MODE_INACTIVE.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/space

Get music space and available options

Choose background_id from options. background_type is 1 (day) or 2 (night); omitting it retains the selected scene's saved type. allowed_types_mask uses bits 1 and 2. Reads work with the music page closed; writes require it open, otherwise 409 MUSIC_MODE_INACTIVE. Reuses device scene persistence and synchronization. A dispatch failure after saving reports saved=true without rollback. Success does not confirm rendering.

GET /v1/api/data/user/music/storage

Get the microSD card status and music file list

Scanning retains same-name, same-size files at distinct paths and includes non-hidden music files from 1 byte to 1 GiB. refresh=1 or true rescans synchronously, even with the music page closed. root_path is the TF card mount root; uploads go into code27/music below it. Listing a file does not validate decoding or guarantee playback. Supported extensions are mp3, wav, flac, aac, m4a, ogg, case-insensitive. capacity_* is bytes; music_files[].path is a device filesystem path, not an HTTP download URL. Empty folders are not listed.

POST /v1/api/data/user/music/upload

Upload music to the microSD card

Use repeated files fields in multipart, with 1–64 files and at most 200 MiB for the entire request. directory is relative to the TF root: omitted means code27/music and an empty string means the TF root. For folder uploads, repeat relative_paths including filenames in files order; the counts must match and directory structure is preserved. Omit relative_paths to use each file's filename. Use / separators; absolute paths, traversal, hidden or reserved folders and symbolic links are rejected. conflict_policy defaults to skip: duplicates appear in rejected with DUPLICATE_FILE. rename creates a unique name; neither policy overwrites. Send raw UTF-8 filenames; spaces, + and literal %20 are not URL-decoded. Leaf names are trimmed and consecutive dots removed. Use uploaded[].name/path as the saved result. Empty files and invalid names are rejected. Partial success returns 200 with uploaded/rejected; all rejected returns 422; excess request size returns 413; invalid file count or relative-path count returns 400. Encode returned paths normally when placing them in URL query parameters.

GET /v1/api/data/user/ability/group-keys

Get available voice groups

Voice groups include group_key (group identity), provider, display_name, voice_ids and clone_voice_ids (clone-capable slots). Use group_key/voice_id from the same group for settings, audition, or cloning; do not derive IDs from display names. Availability varies with AI language and service configuration. ability_type defaults to tts and currently accepts only tts. The language comes from the device's current AI language, not a language query override. Cloud refresh failure can fall back to the last successful catalog; HTTP 200 does not prove that cloud refresh succeeded. clone_voice_names maps voice IDs to names saved for the current user on this device.

POST /v1/api/data/user/agent/results

Submit an asynchronous tool result for speech

Required JSON field: text, with 1–200 characters after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. The result is queued and spoken in the current character voice when the engine is idle; it is saved to chat history as an assistant message before speech starts. HTTP 202 only confirms acceptance into the queue, not completed speech. HTTP 400 indicates invalid input; 503 indicates that the speech service is not ready.

POST /v1/api/data/user/tts/utterances

Create a standalone text utterance

Reads text aloud directly in the current character's voice, without calling an LLM or writing to chat history. The JSON body requires request_id (UUID), slot (the current slot, 1 to 5), and text (1 to 16000 characters after trimming leading and trailing whitespace). The body is limited to 128 KiB, and unknown fields are rejected. The device must be unlocked and meet the current interaction environment, page, and conversation admission rules. Interaction with the screen off follows the current device policy; screen_on alone does not determine admission. Existing interruption rules apply. 202 only means the request was accepted; use GET with utterance_id to check queued/synthesizing/playing/completed/failed/cancelled/cancelling. completed requires both synthesis and device playback to finish. cancel uses an empty body and only cancels tasks created with the same credentials. Retrying with the same credentials, request_id, and content returns the original task (200); different content returns 409. request_id shares a namespace with chat. Tasks and chat turns share a cache of up to 256 entries, terminal states are kept for 30 minutes, and a service restart clears them. Invalid credentials, switching users or characters, or clearing history ends tasks or makes them inaccessible. No audio file or audio stream is returned. A task enters playing only when your CODE27 confirms that playback started for the current playback stream; when animations are allowed, one Talking animation is chosen at random. A task can last up to 180 seconds.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/tts/utterances/{utterance_id}

Get a standalone utterance task

Gets a standalone utterance task created with these credentials, returning the text, state, version, timestamps, and a nullable error. completed requires both synthesis and device playback to finish. Terminal states are kept for 30 minutes; expired tasks and tasks created by other credentials return 404.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}
pathutterance_id是 {"description": "Server utterance task ID for read/cancel, not a voice ID.", "type": "string"}

无已声明的请求正文；签名和具体调用要求见上述说明。

POST /v1/api/data/user/tts/utterances/{utterance_id}/cancel

Cancel a standalone utterance task

The body must be empty. 202 means the cancellation was accepted; tasks already cancelling or cancelled return 200, and completed or failed tasks return 409. Only tasks created with these credentials can be cancelled.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/tts_audition

Start a voice preview

Submit only voice_id and an optional group_key. The backend picks a fixed preview text for the current conversation language and doesn't accept caller-defined text. Success means the command was queued; check synthesis and playback results with /tts_audition/state. Starting a preview interrupts the current foreground conversation.

GET /v1/api/data/user/tts_audition/state

Get the voice preview state

state is global audition state with its last updated_at_ms. There is no per-audition task ID; callers can interrupt each other, so this is not a request_id-specific result. Use /tts/utterances for custom text and trackable tasks. Current state values are IDLE, STARTING, WAITING, PLAYING, ENDED, FAILED.

POST /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/confirm

Confirm a custom voice and optionally apply it

Prepare reference audio → upload for preview → confirm to activate. Upload success does not apply the voice to a character. Use an allowed voice_id slot from 21–25 and a valid group_key. confirm.apply defaults to false; true applies it to the current character. Cloud confirmation can succeed while character application fails with 409 VOICE_CLONE_APPLY_FAILED; this does not roll back confirmation. Returned session_id identifies cloud processing, not pairing; audio_base64 contains preview audio. PUT /voice_clone/display_name updates an existing clone’s local name (at most 32 characters); an empty string restores its default number. Names are shared across language groups of the same provider, persist after restart, and are removed when the clone is deleted. They are not synced to the cloud. GET /voice_clone/quota requires the selected group_key and reads quota without consuming it. remaining_clone_count is the remaining monthly confirmation count; -1 or absent means unlimited. Only MiniMax uses quota; Qwen Audio does not. READY does not consume quota; use the cloud value after ACTIVATED. Deletion does not refund quota. Exhaustion returns HTTP 429, code=VOICE_CLONE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and data.remaining_clone_count=0. Localize errors by code without matching message text; unknown codes use a generic retry message.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

POST /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/delete

Delete a custom voice

Prepare reference audio → upload for preview → confirm to activate. Upload success does not apply the voice to a character. Use an allowed voice_id slot from 21–25 and a valid group_key. confirm.apply defaults to false; true applies it to the current character. Cloud confirmation can succeed while character application fails with 409 VOICE_CLONE_APPLY_FAILED; this does not roll back confirmation. Returned session_id identifies cloud processing, not pairing; audio_base64 contains preview audio. PUT /voice_clone/display_name updates an existing clone’s local name (at most 32 characters); an empty string restores its default number. Names are shared across language groups of the same provider, persist after restart, and are removed when the clone is deleted. They are not synced to the cloud. GET /voice_clone/quota requires the selected group_key and reads quota without consuming it. remaining_clone_count is the remaining monthly confirmation count; -1 or absent means unlimited. Only MiniMax uses quota; Qwen Audio does not. READY does not consume quota; use the cloud value after ACTIVATED. Deletion does not refund quota. Exhaustion returns HTTP 429, code=VOICE_CLONE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and data.remaining_clone_count=0. Localize errors by code without matching message text; unknown codes use a generic retry message.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

POST /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/device_record/start

Start recording reference audio on your CODE27

device_record uses the device microphone. start shows a recording indicator on the device and records for at most 30 seconds. state returns metadata only, never audio. stop stops recording or retrieves the automatically completed WAV; audio_base64 is delivered once, then the buffer is released. Unclaimed audio expires after 5 minutes. Decode Base64 to a file for clone upload. Recording and cloud cloning have separate states.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

已知错误码（task 可由服务商扩展；legacy_error 位于旧接口的 error 字段）

  "http": [
    "UNAUTHORIZED",
    "INVALID_SIGNATURE",
    "LOCAL_SECRET_MISMATCH",
    "LOCAL_SECRET_NOT_INITIALIZED",
    "LOCAL_USER_MISMATCH",
    "LOCAL_SESSION_EXPIRED",
    "REQUEST_EXPIRED",
    "NONCE_REUSED",
    "INVALID_BODY",
    "BODY_TOO_LARGE",
    "PAYLOAD_MODE_MISMATCH",
    "MASTER_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED",
    "CAPABILITY_REQUIRED",
    "VOICE_CLONE_RECORDER_UNAVAILABLE",
    "VOICE_CLONE_RECORD_START_FAILED",
    "VOICE_CLONE_RECORD_STOP_FAILED"
  ]
}
路径、查询及请求头参数
位置名称必填结构与约束
headerX-Local-Body-Hash是 {"description": "Body hash for the payload mode; ordinary bodies use SHA-256 of exact bytes, including the empty-byte hash for empty bodies.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

无已声明的请求正文；签名和具体调用要求见上述说明。

PUT /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/display_name

Rename a custom voice

Prepare reference audio → upload for preview → confirm to activate. Upload success does not apply the voice to a character. Use an allowed voice_id slot from 21–25 and a valid group_key. confirm.apply defaults to false; true applies it to the current character. Cloud confirmation can succeed while character application fails with 409 VOICE_CLONE_APPLY_FAILED; this does not roll back confirmation. Returned session_id identifies cloud processing, not pairing; audio_base64 contains preview audio. PUT /voice_clone/display_name updates an existing clone’s local name (at most 32 characters); an empty string restores its default number. Names are shared across language groups of the same provider, persist after restart, and are removed when the clone is deleted. They are not synced to the cloud. GET /voice_clone/quota requires the selected group_key and reads quota without consuming it. remaining_clone_count is the remaining monthly confirmation count; -1 or absent means unlimited. Only MiniMax uses quota; Qwen Audio does not. READY does not consume quota; use the cloud value after ACTIVATED. Deletion does not refund quota. Exhaustion returns HTTP 429, code=VOICE_CLONE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and data.remaining_clone_count=0. Localize errors by code without matching message text; unknown codes use a generic retry message.

GET /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/quota

Query remaining monthly voice clones for a voice group

Prepare reference audio → upload for preview → confirm to activate. Upload success does not apply the voice to a character. Use an allowed voice_id slot from 21–25 and a valid group_key. confirm.apply defaults to false; true applies it to the current character. Cloud confirmation can succeed while character application fails with 409 VOICE_CLONE_APPLY_FAILED; this does not roll back confirmation. Returned session_id identifies cloud processing, not pairing; audio_base64 contains preview audio. PUT /voice_clone/display_name updates an existing clone’s local name (at most 32 characters); an empty string restores its default number. Names are shared across language groups of the same provider, persist after restart, and are removed when the clone is deleted. They are not synced to the cloud. GET /voice_clone/quota requires the selected group_key and reads quota without consuming it. remaining_clone_count is the remaining monthly confirmation count; -1 or absent means unlimited. Only MiniMax uses quota; Qwen Audio does not. READY does not consume quota; use the cloud value after ACTIVATED. Deletion does not refund quota. Exhaustion returns HTTP 429, code=VOICE_CLONE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and data.remaining_clone_count=0. Localize errors by code without matching message text; unknown codes use a generic retry message.

HTTP default · Invalid parameters, processing failure, or service unavailable; handle based on the status code and returned fields, and don't blindly retry write operations

POST /v1/api/data/user/voice_clone/upload

Upload reference audio and create a custom voice

Audio files are limited to 10 MiB, and the whole request to 10 MiB plus 64 KiB. voice_id must be 21 to 25, and group_key is required. File limits are enforced before the form is first parsed. Prepare reference audio → upload for preview → confirm to activate. Upload success does not apply the voice to a character. Use an allowed voice_id slot from 21–25 and a valid group_key. confirm.apply defaults to false; true applies it to the current character. Cloud confirmation can succeed while character application fails with 409 VOICE_CLONE_APPLY_FAILED; this does not roll back confirmation. Returned session_id identifies cloud processing, not pairing; audio_base64 contains preview audio. PUT /voice_clone/display_name updates an existing clone’s local name (at most 32 characters); an empty string restores its default number. Names are shared across language groups of the same provider, persist after restart, and are removed when the clone is deleted. They are not synced to the cloud. GET /voice_clone/quota requires the selected group_key and reads quota without consuming it. remaining_clone_count is the remaining monthly confirmation count; -1 or absent means unlimited. Only MiniMax uses quota; Qwen Audio does not. READY does not consume quota; use the cloud value after ACTIVATED. Deletion does not refund quota. Exhaustion returns HTTP 429, code=VOICE_CLONE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and data.remaining_clone_count=0. Localize errors by code without matching message text; unknown codes use a generic retry message.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

headerX-Local-Nonce是 {"description": "Fresh per-request nonce, 1–128 characters, without pipe/newline.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Payload-Mode是 {"description": "Payload mode matching JSON, empty body, multipart, or compressed chunks.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Session-Id否 {"description": "Temporary pairing-session identity; include in signed requests when nonempty, not a cloud voice session_id.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Sig是 {"description": "Hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical string; see signing contract.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-Timestamp是 {"description": "Unix seconds, not milliseconds; permitted clock skew is 300 seconds.", "type": "string"}
headerX-Local-User-Id是 {"description": "Current user identity associated with pairing, not machine_id.", "type": "string"}

GET /v1/api/data/user/light-projects

List light projects

A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

POST /v1/api/data/user/light-projects

Create a light project

The LED count is fixed at 17. A project can have up to 6 segments with 16 layers each, and segment and project durations are limited to 60000 ms. The frame rate is 1 to 30 (omitted or 0 uses 30), and a whole project can expand to at most 10800 frames. Budgets are checked before frame filling and compilation; exceeding a limit returns 400. Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

GET /v1/api/data/user/light-projects/applied

Get the applied light project

A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/light-projects/preview

Preview a saved light project or draft

The body must contain exactly one of project_id or project. project_id loads a saved project owned by the current user; project provides a complete draft, with no need to save it or provide projectId. Both are temporary previews. The LED count is fixed at 17. A project can have up to 6 segments with 16 layers each, and segment and project durations are limited to 60000 ms. The frame rate is 1 to 30 (omitted or 0 uses 30), and a whole project can expand to at most 10800 frames. Budgets are checked before frame filling and compilation; exceeding a limit returns 400. A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

POST /v1/api/data/user/light-projects/preview/stop

Stop the light preview

A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

PUT /v1/api/data/user/light-projects/{projectId}

Update a light project

The LED count is fixed at 17. A project can have up to 6 segments with 16 layers each, and segment and project durations are limited to 60000 ms. The frame rate is 1 to 30 (omitted or 0 uses 30), and a whole project can expand to at most 10800 frames. Budgets are checked before frame filling and compilation; exceeding a limit returns 400. Creating with an existing ID returns 409; updating an ID that doesn't exist returns 404. Submit the complete resource. Omitting a required field or submitting null returns 400, and existing settings are never overwritten with default zero values. A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

POST /v1/api/data/user/light-projects/{projectId}/apply

Apply a light project

A project document differs from a device playback program. Save persists the document; compile returns compilation output; preview is temporary and does not apply the project; apply selects a saved project; preview/stop ends preview. applied sourceType/sourceId/projectId describe the selected source, not frame rendering confirmation. mode is normal or reactive; ledCount=0 normalizes to 17. durationMs/startMs/contentDurationMs are milliseconds. ledRange.start/endInclusive are zero-based and inclusive; RGB channels are 0–255. Limits: 6 segments, 300–60000 ms each, total at most 60000 ms, 16 layers per segment, up to 30 fps. version is the project format version (nonpositive normalizes to 2), not a catalog optimistic-lock revision; updatedAt is Unix milliseconds. Compile-report degraded/degradationReason can indicate resampling/quantization rather than failure. Reactive and ordinary layer parameters have different scales; do not treat all as percentages. layer.kind is procedural or frame_patch; priority is IDLE/MUSIC/INTERACTION/ALERT. Ordinary layer type supports STATIC/BREATHE/CHASE/PULSE/BLINK; brightness is an integer 0–255 and speed is 1–100. frame_patch uses fps, frames[].colors, contentDurationMs and keyframes frame indices. Reactive intensity/sensitivity/brightness/motion/sparkAmount/trailLength/noiseGate are 0–1 with omitted defaults 0.7/0.55/1/0.6/0.35/0.55/0.15; explicit zero is kept. smooth, beatBoost, keepBaseWhenSilent default true and preserve explicit false. lowColor/midColor/highColor are frequency-band colors; baseColor is the compatible low-band input.

鉴权：LocalHMAC · 功能权限：无额外能力标记

codestring是Machine-readable business error identifier; some older endpoints omit it.
messagestring—Diagnostic text, not a stable machine error code.
successboolean是Result of this endpoint operation; inspect task/device state for async completion. {"const": false}
JSON Schema 原文
{
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "description": "Machine-readable business error identifier; some older endpoints omit it.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "message": {
      "description": "Diagnostic text, not a stable machine error code.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "success": {
      "const": false,
      "description": "Result of this endpoint operation; inspect task/device state for async completion.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }

  "required": [
    "success",
    "code"
  ],
  "type": "object"
